name: Reed cove: a shallow cove with cattails and rushes
in_game: Coves and creek mouths by rule (shallow, sheltered): ground is terrain, the plants are Track B's (these are stand-ins)
real: A sheltered cove less than half a metre deep, soft mud banks, a patchy stand of cattails 1.2-2.4 m with brown heads and rushes nearer the bank, open channels through it, a drift of dead stems and leaves at the edge.

stems.source: stand-in count over 16 m; Track B sets the real density
